definitions: A British iron sailing steamship designed by Isambard Kingdom Brunel, and launched in 1858. She was the largest ship ever built at the time of her launching, and had the capacity to carry 4,000 passengers around the world without refueling.
A former British railway company that operated in East Anglia and London from 1862 to 1922.
examples: The Great Eastern was a marvel of Victorian engineering.
The Great Eastern Railway played a significant role in the development of suburban London.
